protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.

procedure_steps.instruction: Allocate a fresh 0.5 mL milk sample for each selected food test; apply only that test's reviewed reagent protocol.

procedure_steps.instruction: Heat 5 mL 1% sucrose with 5 drops concentrated HCl on a boiling-water bath; cool and add NaOH until neutral/slightly alkaline. Use separate aliquots for subsequent reducing-sugar tests.
procedure_steps.observation: Hydrolysed sucrose gives the source's reducing-sugar response; neutralisation dose is not fixed.

quantities.note: Neutral/slightly alkaline endpoint; no volume given.
